description: Negative: Procedure missing required procedureName field
shaclConstraintViolated: clinical:ProcedureShape requires a procedure name through an sh:or over clinical:procedureName and health:procedureName (clinical v1.15). This record carries neither, so the sh:or is unsatisfied.
notes: Tests that a procedure with no name in EITHER spelling is rejected. Retargeted in clinical v1.15 from the undefined health:ProcedureRecord onto clinical:Procedure, which clinical:ProcedureShape targets, so this is now a live negative rather than UNSHAPED. It is also the regression guard on the v1.15 sh:or: a mis-authored sh:or would make the name OPTIONAL rather than either-spelling, and this fixture is what catches that.
